units.source_text: 中午时分，我又到客厅去找夫人，

en.t: At noon, I went again to the sitting room to find the lady of the house,

units.source_text: 问她打算什么时候把今天上午说的事情告诉小姐。

en.t: and asked when she intended to tell the young lady about what we had discussed that morning.

units.source_text: 夫人说：‘只要她本人乐意，什么时候说都无所谓吧。’

en.t: She said, "As long as the girl herself is willing, it should not matter when I tell her."

units.source_text: 看起来，夫人似乎比我更像个男子汉。

en.t: At that point, she seemed more manly than I was.
I was just about to leave,

units.source_text: 夫人叫住我说：‘如果你觉得早点说好，今天也可以。

en.t: and she stopped me and said, "If you think sooner is better, today would be fine.

units.source_text: 她学琴回来，我就告诉她。’

en.t: When she comes back from her koto lesson, I will tell her."

units.source_text: 说完，我又回到自己房中。

en.t: After saying that, I went back to my own room.

units.source_text: 然而，当我想到自己坐在桌前远远地听着她们两个窃窃私语的情形时，

en.t: But when I imagined myself sitting at my desk and listening from a distance to the two of them whispering,

units.source_text: 不知怎的，心里就扑通扑通乱跳。

en.t: for some reason my heart began to pound and I could not calm down.

units.source_text: 我终于坐不住了，戴上帽子出了家门。

en.t: At last I could not sit still, so I put on my hat and left the house.

units.source_text: 谁知走到坡下时，遇见了回家的小姐。

en.t: But when I reached the foot of the slope, I ran into the young lady coming home.

units.source_text: 一无所知的小姐看见我，好像有点惊讶。

en.t: The young lady, who knew nothing, seemed a little surprised when she saw me.

units.source_text: 我摘下帽子打了个招呼：‘回来啦？’

en.t: I took off my hat and greeted her, "You are back?"

units.source_text: 小姐颇感意外地问道：‘你病好了？’

en.t: She asked, looking rather surprised, "Have you recovered from your illness?"
"Yes, I have. I am well now."

units.source_text: 我回答，然后快步向水道桥那边拐过去了。

en.t: I answered, then quickly turned off toward Suidobashi.
